$schema_doc: Each longform video (a full livestream recording, landscape) is one object in the longs[] array. Mirrors shorts.json but for the longform pipeline. The video file lives under longform/ relative to the schedule-tweets root (e.g. 'longform/<slug>.mp4'); prefer no-spaces slug filenames so the dashboard video player resolves cleanly. Each long can be queued to the platforms that have a longform uploader script: rumble (upload-longform-rumble.js), bitchute (upload-longform-bitchute.js), facebook (upload-longform-facebook.js). Each platform has its own independent status flow: pending -> posting -> posted -> failed (or 'skip' to never post there). 'description' is the base description used as the post body/caption (Rumble/BitChute use title+description+tags; Facebook builds its caption from title+description with hashtags stripped). NOTE: the upload scripts currently read the single staged video + metadata.json from the longform/ folder, NOT from this JSON yet — this file is the dashboard queue/record; wiring the scripts to consume it is a future step.
